items.title: Saba Capital founder Boaz Weinstein announces plans for UK REIT activist campaign
items.summary: Saba Capital Management founder Boaz Weinstein has outlined plans to target UK real estate investment trusts including Grainger and Derwent.

items.title: MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard scheduled for public launch in summer 2027
items.summary: Research from the Money and Pensions Service indicates one in eight users discovered a lost pension during testing, ahead of a summer 2027 public release.

items.title: NTSB releases preliminary report on fatal November helicopter crash in Biscayne Bay
items.summary: A National Transportation Safety Board report indicates a helicopter filming a powerboat event was flying extremely close to the water before crashing.

items.title: Liontrust posts statutory loss following River Global acquisition costs
items.summary: Investment Week reports Liontrust recorded a statutory pre-tax loss for the six months to September, driven by acquisition and amortisation expenses.

items.title: Ceta Insurance head of intermediary discusses growth areas in video series
items.summary: Insurance Age features Ceta Insurance's Mark Chappell in its Broker Expo Bites video series to discuss technology and business growth.

items.title: UK financial regulators propose new cyber resilience guidance
items.summary: UK financial watchdogs have laid out proposed guidance on cyber resilience amid rising artificial intelligence risks.
